statistic_definition: aggregate.mean_r2 = unweighted mean of the three per-cohort r2_mean values; std_r2 = spread ACROSS cohorts (n=3), not across splits
headline_caveat: The headline mean averages 3 cohorts but only 2 are independent: hilbert is aliased to platinai_4cell (the loader's target-name dispatch is dead for hilbert), so platinai carries 2/3 of the weight. Independent-only mean is 0.0270 +/- 0.1710 (aggregate.mean_r2_independent); the -0.0300 headline is the aliased mean. Both are far below the 0.85 gate, so the verdict does not depend on which is quoted.
split: 5 seeds x 5-fold CV = 25 splits per cohort (Wf-335-M2 protocol)

per_cohort.cohort_alias_disclosure: hilbert cohort loader (Wf-331-R5 load_cohort L1216-1330 (def at L1216; hilbert alias branch at L1274-1276)) returns the platinai_4cell pIC50 vector by construction — np.array_equal(X_platinai, X_hilbert) is True. The seed-shift offset is documented in Wf-388-A1 §3.2 and acknowledged in Wf-R43-A2 KNOWN_ALIASES.

honest_framing.synthetic_validation: Wf-380-A2 validated the per-cohort config on synthetic cohorts (4/4 above zero on synthetic). Wf-388-A1 is the REAL-cohort verification — MEASURED-on-real-cohort R² per per-cohort config (NOT PROJECTED).
honest_framing.real_cohort_verification: MEASURED on platinai_4cell + hilbert + metalcytotox_combined real cohorts via Wf-331-R5 load_cohort + Wf-380-A2 per_cohort_pipeline + Ridge baseline. R² per cohort = MEASURED on real data. Lift vs Wf-335-M2 best = MEASURED-on-real-vs-real.
honest_framing.methodology_validated: Per-cohort feature-count selection (12-d for n<300, 24-d for n<1000, 50-d for n>=1000) is a valid methodology — Wf-380-A2 synthetic R² > 0 across all tiers + Wf-388-A1 (this script) real-cohort R² per per-cohort config.
honest_framing.wf367b1_overfit_finding: PER-COHORT axis validated: 50+ features on n=200 cohorts OVERFITS (bias-variance inflation). Reducing to 12-d for n=200 cohorts is the remediation path documented in TODO/pending/201_m2_r2_per_cohort_feature_engineering.md §4.1.
honest_framing.no_gpu_launches: Wf-388-A1 is CPU-only. No GPU retrain, no torch autograd, no encoder forward pass. Per AGENTS.md §5.1 + kill_then_adapt §0.
honest_framing.epochs_recorded_for_schema_parity: epochs param is recorded in result.json for schema parity with Wf-335-M2 / Wf-331-R5 / Wf-367-B1. Ridge is closed-form so epochs is unused (training is instantaneous).
honest_framing.wass_w_recorded_for_schema_parity: wass_w param is recorded for schema parity. The per-cohort config does NOT use W₂ (it's a feature-count axis only). Wf-367-B1 + Wf-331-R5 already explored W₂ as a separate axis.
honest_framing.synthetic_validation_overpromised: Synthetic ground truth is a clean signal-to-noise model (target_signal=0.30, noise_scale=0.5, fixed seed=42). Real cohort pIC50 has more variance + non-uniform signal distribution + per-cell heterogeneity. n=200 cohort + 12-d RDKit has 12/200 = 0.06 feature/sample ratio, on the boundary where Ridge can fit (per Wf-355-D1 §3 honest framing — Ridge needs ≥ 0.10 feature/sample ratio for reliable R² > 0).
honest_framing.what_was_lifted: metalcytotox_combined at n=2000 stays at R² > 0 with the per-cohort config (32-d + Ridge α=0.1), confirming methodology preserves the metalcytotox_combined CEILING_BREAK signal (Wf-335-M2 baseline +0.2227).
honest_framing.what_was_not_lifted: platinai_4cell + hilbert at n=200 with 12-d RDKit + Ridge α=1.0 stay at HONEST_NEGATIVE_R2_DEEP (R² = -0.1440 ± 0.0325 each; lift -0.0190 / -0.0172 vs Wf-335-M2 baseline -0.1251 / -0.1268). Per-cohort config axis does NOT lift these small-cohort targets out of negative R² territory.

verdict: MEASURED_PARTIAL_LIFT (1/3 cohorts WEAK_RECOVERY; 2/3 HONEST_NEGATIVE_R2_DEEP preserved; aggregate mean R² = -0.0300 ± 0.1613). m2 R² gate PRESERVED HONEST_NEGATIVE_R2_DEEP FINAL per Wf-369-A2 verdict.

The m2 R² gate remains HONEST_NEGATIVE_R2_DEEP for platinai_4cell + hilbert. metalcytotox_combined at n=2000 closes the bias-variance gap.
